paper_title: Molecular mechanisms that stabilize short term synaptic plasticity during presynaptic homeostatic plasticity
brain_region_or_neural_cell_type: larval neuromuscular junction glutamatergic motor neuron synapse
perturbation_or_condition: philanthotoxin-induced postsynaptic glutamate receptor inhibition plus RIM, Rop/Unc18, and Syntaxin1A genetic perturbations
primary_assay_or_readout: electrophysiology of mEPSP/EPSC amplitude, quantal content, and paired-pulse short-term plasticity
key_quantitative_result: PhTx reduced miniature EPSP amplitude by about 50% while the homeostatic response increased presynaptic release by more than 200% and preserved paired-pulse plasticity
main_mechanistic_conclusion: RIM and Unc18/Rop support the primed and super-primed vesicle balance required for PHP, while Syntaxin1A restrains Unc18/Rop to stabilize short-term plasticity

paper_title: Imaging neuropeptide release at synapses with a genetically engineered reporter
brain_region_or_neural_cell_type: larval neuromuscular junction type III boutons and adult brain neuropeptide-expressing neurons
perturbation_or_condition: electrical stimulation frequency titration and tetanus-toxin-mediated release blockade
primary_assay_or_readout: live fluorescence imaging of genetically encoded Neuropeptide Release Reporters (NPRR-ANP and NPRR-dTK)
key_quantitative_result: NPRR-dTK showed larger normalized peak deltaF/F than NPRR-ANP, including 18.14% at 30 Hz and 82.40% at 50 Hz versus 3.57% and 24.67% for NPRR-ANP
main_mechanistic_conclusion: NPRRs traffic to dense-core vesicles and report stimulation-evoked neuropeptide release with cellular specificity and real-time optical readout

paper_title: Light-induced engagement of microglia to focally remodel synapses in the adult brain
brain_region_or_neural_cell_type: adult retrosplenial cortex dendritic spines, axonal boutons, and microglia
perturbation_or_condition: two-photon laser photodamage near individual synaptic structures; PLX3397 microglia depletion
primary_assay_or_readout: in vivo two-photon structural imaging of microglia-neuron contact and spine/bouton remodeling
key_quantitative_result: Microglia contact area increased from 0.53% to 4.39% after Spine-PD and from 0.24% to 3.79% after Near-Spine-PD; Near-Bouton-PD induced filopodia in 79.55% of cases
main_mechanistic_conclusion: Focal synaptic photodamage prolongs microglial contact and drives local spine and bouton remodeling; microglia depletion abolishes turnover but not all new filopodia generation

paper_title: Latrophilin GPCR signaling mediates synapse formation
brain_region_or_neural_cell_type: hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons; entorhinal cortex and Schaffer collateral inputs
perturbation_or_condition: conditional deletion of Lphn2 or Lphn3 with rescue by wild-type or signaling-deficient T4L/ECT/DCt latrophilin mutants
primary_assay_or_readout: HEK293 cAMP reporter assays, cultured hippocampal neuron synapse imaging, slice electrophysiology, and rabies monosynaptic tracing
key_quantitative_result: Lphn3 deletion reduced excitatory synapse density by about 40% and reduced mEPSC frequency; WT Lphn3 rescued the phenotype whereas ECD, T4L, and DCt mutants did not
main_mechanistic_conclusion: Latrophilin-2 and Latrophilin-3 require postsynaptic GPCR signaling, not adhesion alone, to establish input-specific excitatory synapses in hippocampal CA1

paper_title: Astrocyte GluN2C NMDA receptors control basal synaptic strengths of hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons in the stratum radiatum
brain_region_or_neural_cell_type: adult hippocampal CA1 stratum radiatum astrocytes and Schaffer collateral inputs onto pyramidal neurons
perturbation_or_condition: pharmacological NMDAR blockade, astrocyte-specific Grin1 knockdown, and GluN2C-focused NMDAR perturbation
primary_assay_or_readout: whole-cell patch-clamp paired-pulse ratio/EPSC recordings, astrocyte NMDA-glycine puff responses, single-cell qPCR, and computational plasticity modeling
key_quantitative_result: Internal MK801 blocked over 92% of synaptic NMDAR currents; astrocyte Grin1 knockdown reduced NMDA-glycine depolarization in stratum radiatum astrocytes and reduced PPR variance without changing mean PPR
main_mechanistic_conclusion: Astrocyte GluN2C-containing NMDARs maintain a broad distribution of presynaptic strengths at Schaffer collateral synapses, which supports long-term plasticity capacity
